ticker_news.title: Billionaire Philippe Laffont Sold 53% of Coatue's AMD Stake in Favor of an ETF Whose Underlying Asset Has Gained Nearly 165,000,000% in 15 Years
ticker_news.description: Billionaire Philippe Laffont reduced his stake in Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) by 53% while simultaneously investing in the iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF, potentially due to concerns about AMD's AI competitiveness and Bitcoin's potential as an inflation hedge.
ticker_news.author: Sean Williams

ticker_news.title: Mohammed bin Salman-Backed Humain Begins Building 100MW AI Data Centers With Nvidia, AMD's Latest Chips
ticker_news.description: Saudi AI company Humain is constructing two 100MW data centers in Riyadh and Dammam, launching in early 2026, using advanced chips from Nvidia and AMD to support Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 tech ambitions.
ticker_news.author: Ananya Gairola

ticker_news.title: 3 Reasons to Buy Super Micro Stock Before It's Too Late
ticker_news.description: Super Micro Computer offers a compelling long-term AI investment through its hardware infrastructure business, trading at a significant discount despite operational challenges and market uncertainties in the generative AI sector.
ticker_news.author: Will Ebiefung

QQQ.title: Is the Schwab US Dividend Equity ETF a Safer Bet in a Volatile Market?
QQQ.description: With the S&P 500 near all-time highs driven by tech stocks, the Schwab US Dividend Equity ETF offers a more conservative investment approach with a lower valuation and attractive dividend yield.
QQQ.author: Reuben Gregg Brewer
